title: Instant messages from AI Portal, sign-up from a link, sturdier bug reports
notes:
- The confirm step now also finishes when the email carries a confirmation link instead of a code: click the link, come back, you are signed in
- Clearer wording when an address is not confirmed yet
- Messages from AI Portal arrive seconds after launch or sign-in (not up to 5 minutes later), spring out of the bell and play their own longer chime; they can be addressed to one account
- A bug report goes through even when its attachments cannot be uploaded
